paintings.title: Whispers of Autumn
paintings.description: A meditative walk through golden-brown foliage at dusk. The interplay of warm ochres and cool shadows captures the bittersweet beauty of transition — the moment summer breathes its last and autumn takes hold. Painted alla prima with palette knife for textured leaf layers.

paintings.title: Silent Tides
paintings.description: The sea at dawn — before the world wakes. Layered blues and greys build a atmosphere of solitude and vastness. A single boat on the horizon reminds us of our smallness, and our belonging to something greater.

paintings.title: The Thoughtful One
paintings.description: A portrait study in introspection. The subject turns slightly away, caught mid-thought. Charcoal smudging creates soft transitions, while sharp ink lines define the contours of a mind at work. The unfinished quality invites the viewer to complete the narrative.

paintings.title: Urban Solitude
paintings.description: A rain-slicked city street at midnight — reflections of neon signs ripple across wet asphalt. The lone figure with an umbrella walks away from the viewer, a study in urban loneliness wrapped in vibrant colour.

paintings.title: Roots & Wings
paintings.description: An abstract exploration of heritage and freedom. Tree roots morph into bird wings at the top — grounded yet reaching. Gold leaf accents catch the light differently depending on where you stand, symbolising how perspective shapes meaning.

paintings.title: Golden Hour Fields
paintings.description: Wheat fields stretching to the horizon under a late afternoon sun. Every stroke carries the warmth of the season — the kind of light that makes you want to close your eyes and breathe deeply.

paintings.title: Fractured Light
paintings.description: Light breaks through a prism — or perhaps through a stained glass window shattered and reassembled. Geometric colour fields overlap and collide, creating a visual rhythm that shifts with every glance.

paintings.title: The Dancers
paintings.description: Two figures in motion — bodies intertwined in a dance that speaks of connection, trust, and the joy of moving as one. Loose brushwork conveys the energy of the moment while selective detail anchors the emotion.

paintings.title: Meditation in Blue
paintings.description: A minimalist study in shades of blue — from cerulean to indigo. What appears simple at first reveals subtle washes, granulation textures, and negative space that forms an unassuming meditative figure.
